commit.message:
fix(sovereign-legacy): preserve upstream tariff and served-model provenance

The legacy runner (src/index.ts, start:legacy) reads the same
SOVEREIGN_GPT_URL/SOVEREIGN_GLM_URL env vars as v4 but still hard-coded
tariff_dependency=false in executor receipts, lockstep metadata, all five
terminal envelopes and lifecycle telemetry, and its error path carried no
provenance at all. Mirror the v4 rule by reusing upstream_provenance.ts:
custom endpoints default tariff-dependent, proved-local requires explicit
opt-out with fail-LOUD validation, mergeUpstreamProvenance supplies the
full served-model/zero-spend/data-policy field set, executor errors keep
endpoint provenance, lockstep derives per-actor dependency, a sticky
accumulator feeds all terminal envelopes, and lifecycle telemetry reports
CONFIGURATION_MINIMUM with per-actor breakdown.

Closes OBS-SOV-LEGACY-3 from GLM review #243. canonical=false,
authority_effect=false, PREPARE_ONLY.
